gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, seasonally adjusted (Stats NZ via OECD quarterly national accounts, T0102)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, production measure, chain-linked volume, seasonally adjusted (Stats NZ via OECD, T0101)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous quarter, seasonally adjusted (Stats NZ via OECD, T0101)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier, seasonally adjusted (Stats NZ via OECD, T0101)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, 15+, seasonally adjusted, quarterly (Stats NZ household labour force survey via OECD)

bond_yield_10y.label: 10-year government bond yield (OECD long-term interest rate, IRLT)

business_confidence.label: Business confidence (OECD BCICP, amplitude-adjusted, long-term average = 100)

policy_rate.label: Official cash rate (BIS central bank policy rates, M.NZ, from April 1999)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, change on same quarter a year earlier, from Stats NZ's all-items index (via OECD)

cpi_qoq.label: CPI, all items, change on previous quarter, from Stats NZ's all-items index (via OECD)

exports.label: Exports of goods, FOB, converted from US dollars at each month's rate (IMF international trade in goods)

imports.label: Imports of goods, CIF, converted from US dollars at each month's rate (IMF international trade in goods)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports FOB less imports CIF, converted from US dollars (IMF ITG)
